purpose: Evaluator evidence templates, not solver-generated acceptance criteria or universal aesthetic thresholds

templates.observable: Declared accepted artifact bytes before and after the scoped revision
templates.limits: Byte equality proves preservation only. Changes may be intentional in nonaccepted artifacts; visual quality is still separately reviewed.

templates.observable: Intended label and its event anchor, their spacing/alignment at actual output size
templates.units: Optional normalized geometric distance after an independent selector; ordinal visual grouping anchors
templates.evidence: Actual size preview + independent element mapping
templates.limits: Do not infer semantic grouping solely from source presence, font count or a global fixed pixel threshold. The bundled baseline measure is only a trusted calibration fixture.

templates.observable: Feature contact/support relation, including body-side ownership in reverse views
templates.units: Contact distance in a declared coordinate frame; ordinal cross-view support consistency
templates.evidence: Actual relevant views; independent anchor mapping
templates.limits: A static contact measure does not prove cloth deformation or physics; annotate uncertainty.

templates.observable: Relevant subject position/shape/material and timing across the named state join
templates.units: Declared normalized position/speed/time series with timestamps; visible discontinuity anchors
templates.evidence: Trusted browser/native playback capture across the join, not endpoints or a solver-authored score
templates.limits: No numerical continuity score without an actual sampled trace and declared uncertainty/tolerance. Count of frames or motion terminology is not quality.

templates.observable: Opaque layer separation, edge thickness/fold treatment and relevant arm transition
templates.units: Ordinal visual evidence anchored to the specific brief
templates.evidence: Actual full-size and detail previews; optional independently verified material/native cloth study
templates.limits: A caption stating airy/light is not material evidence. A flat SVG does not establish physical cloth weight.

not_applicable_rule: Use not_applicable only when the atom is inactive by its frozen turn applicability; do not use it to hide an active failed or unobserved requirement.
